seats.text:
I implemented `format` in `format.ts` following the README, but I haven't run it, so it is untested against any inputs.

The main design choice is exact rounding. It splits each double into its exact binary value using BigInt arithmetic. Every rounding step (`e`, `f` and `g`) then rounds to nearest with ties to even, so `%.2f` of 2.675 gives `2.67` and `%.0f` of 2.5 gives `2`.

It covers all the conversions in the README. That includes the `0`-flag rules, `#` handling, `-0`, `inf`/`nan`, and `s`/`c` precision and padding.

I made no changes outside `format.ts`.
